title: Prototype Chain
concept: Objects are linked via [[Prototype]], and property lookups traverse the chain upward

steps.title: animal object (shared method)
steps.explanation:
Creating the animal object.
The `eat` method here will be borrowed later by `dog`.
Instead of each object copying the method, they **share** one instance to save memory.

steps.title: Creating the dog object
steps.explanation:
Creating the dog object with a bark method.
Not yet connected to animal.

steps.title: Linking the prototype
steps.explanation:
Setting dog's [[Prototype]] to animal.
Now the chain dog → animal → Object.prototype is established.

steps.title: Calling its own method
steps.explanation: dog.bark() is found directly on dog itself, so it's returned immediately.

steps.title: Searching up the prototype chain
steps.explanation: dog.eat() isn't on dog, so the chain is traversed and eat is found on animal.
steps.keyInsight: If a property isn't found, the lookup walks up the [[Prototype]] chain

steps.title: Searching all the way to Object.prototype
steps.explanation: toString() isn't on dog or animal, so it's found at Object.prototype.
steps.keyInsight: Every object ultimately inherits from Object.prototype

quiz.question: What happens when you call dog.fly()?
options: TypeError: dog.fly is not a function
quiz.explanation:
Searching to the end of the chain (null) without finding fly yields undefined.
Calling undefined() throws a TypeError.

misconceptions.wrong: JavaScript is class-based like Java or C++
misconceptions.correct: Even with the ES6 class keyword, JavaScript works internally through **prototypes (links between objects)**.
misconceptions.why: Where classes stamp out copies from a blueprint, prototypes delegate to a parent object.

misconceptions.correct: Most browsers support it, but the official recommendation is to use `Object.getPrototypeOf()`.
misconceptions.why: __proto__ should be avoided due to performance concerns and compatibility issues.

keyTakeaway: Prototype chain = property lookup path; if not found, walk up the chain
